meeting_point: Kuhio Beach Hula Mound  @ 2451 Kalakaua Ave, Honolulu, Hawaii 96815
description: This inclusive Bike Tour with four (4) foodie stops for food tasting is designed to acquaint travelers with local knowledge of Hawaii's Iconic eateries.
what_is_included: We provide food tasting at four local locations in Honolulu. This tour includes cooked fish, shaved Ice, and a Malasada. We provide a 7-speed city bike with a protective helmet and cold water. We can adjust the menu for vegan or vegetarian.
itinerary: We roll out of Waikiki, approximately 1-3 miles, to taste paradise.
highlights: We will visit select Local Foodie stops outside of Waikiki with informative narration and complementary photos.
check_in_details: We don't have a retail location. We meet our guests at the Kuhio Beach Hula Mound.  AKA: Kuhio Beach Park. Address located at 2451 Kalakaua Ave, Honolulu, Hawaii 96815. There is a huge Banyan tree with a cutout for cars to pick up and drop off people.
what_to_bring: Wear covered shoes, We have a small bag on the bike for your phone/wallet.
